item.title: Otraku v1.12.1
item.description:
Otraku 1.12.1 | Otraku-v.1.12.1-ios15+
- Added support for the new AniList notification types, which fixes the recent app errors. - Media activity filter has a "Self" option now (thanks @0-BlackSpectrum-0). - Bar charts in user/media statistics are not horizontal, more compact and more informative (thanks @0-BlackSpectrum-0). - Buttons on the user page are now a grid (thanks @0-BlackSpectrum-0). - Android app icon changes depending on light/dark mode (thanks @0-BlackSpectrum-0). - Fixed the status bar tint on older android versions (thanks @0-BlackSpectrum-0). - Fixed layout issues with the text being cut off.
